newest.headline: Sign-in, the CurseForge browser and the in-game menu

items.text: The Microsoft account the game reads now matches the one the launcher exports.
CurseForge lists Bedrock content before you search, in sections, with each project's own picture.
XAPK and zip packages import from the device, with progress.
The floating Mod Menu button opens the menu again, and says so when a build cannot.
The logcat overlay switch applies at once instead of at the next launch.

upcoming.headline: What is being worked on next

items.text: The replay recorder capturing the full world from BerryAPI's native world feed, not only the local player and voice peers.
BerryAPI's encrypted voice system, replacing the launcher's own relay settings.
More authored cape art and preview poses.
